title: alchemilla vulgaris subvar. heteropoda
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subvar. heteropoda, commonly known as the Lady's Mantle, is a plant species known for its medicinal and ornamental properties. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may aid in treating wounds, reducing menstrual cramps, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include astringent, antidiarrheal, and antispasmodic effects, making it a useful remedy for digestive issues and menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
